label: Corpus B candidate run: eight frozen, externally sourced, output-mutation-applicable cards attempted; four source cards excluded under recorded structural predicates; independent review pending.
method: For each card the probe runs at the PARENT of the fix commit and again at the fix commit. The second run is the control: a probe returning the same result on both sides is not measuring the defect. Promptfoo's own modules are imported directly; nothing is reimplemented.

detection power: evalmut's operators were not executed against promptfoo in this pass
generality: eight cards from one repository, chosen by one person
no percentage, ranking or score is derivable from this bundle and none is published here
what_this_run_establishes: That each executed card's defect REPRODUCES against promptfoo's own code at the commit before its fix, and is absent at the fix. It does NOT establish that evalmut detects these defects: no evalmut operator was run in this pass. Card validity against real code and detection power are different claims and this bundle supports only the first.
